name: Escape Through Force
summary: In Darkshore, Volcor fights through the wild to reach safety. He finds Grimclaw by the road, and you bring word of his escape to Terenthis in Auberdine.

sections.title: A Direct Way Out
sections.body: Volcor is stranded in Darkshore’s perilous wilderness, with danger closing around him. He chooses to fight the hostile creatures instead of slipping away unseen. His skill clears a path to the main road and safety.

sections.title: Reunion on the Road
sections.body: Volcor reaches the road and meets Grimclaw, his bear companion, who waited by the path. Safe at last, Volcor prepares for his next journey and asks you to report to Terenthis in Auberdine. His escape reaches the night elf leadership and draws Sentinel Selarin’s attention to troubles in southern Ashenvale.

faq.answer: Volcor is a night elf scout or woodsman in Darkshore who went missing with his companion Grimclaw. After you find him while searching for Terenthis, he needs help escaping hostile wildlife and dangerous terrain.
Grimclaw is Volcor’s loyal bear companion. While Volcor was trapped, Grimclaw waited apart from him near the road, where they could meet again.

faq.q: Why does Terenthis care about Volcor's return?
faq.answer: Terenthis coordinates scout movements and local defenses from Auberdine. Finding lost allies and judging threats along the coast helps the night elves hold Darkshore.

faq.q: What happens after completing this quest?
faq.answer: You report Volcor’s safe passage to Terenthis in Auberdine. The next stage leads to Trek to Ashenvale.

faq.q: Is there an alternate way to finish Volcor's escort?
faq.answer: Yes. You can fight your way out with Volcor or guide him quietly past danger using stealth.

faq.q: Where does this quest lead in the broader storyline?
faq.answer: Volcor’s safe return links Darkshore’s local conflicts to the defense of night elf lands and opens assignments in Ashenvale.

angles.text: As a night elf, you help protect the Kaldorei’s hold on Darkshore, where wild beasts, corruption, and outside invaders threaten their ancestral woodlands.
As an Alliance member, you strengthen the bond between the young Alliance and the Night Elves by helping secure Kalimdor’s northern frontier.
